knowledge-engine.gate: Jeremy can open the product, ask a real research question, and receive a useful evidence-backed answer end-to-end.

rocksmith.gate: Jeremy can provide a song and obtain a genuinely playable Rocksmith CDLC with acceptable note and timing alignment.

everward.gate: Jeremy can launch and play a coherent vertical slice.

voicestudio.gate: Jeremy can provide or record a voice, choose a singing target, and produce a listenable singing output through a usable workflow.

rules: Prefer capability slices that remove a proven blocker to the next usability gate.
Keep every safely executable product advancing; waiting gates do not consume worker capacity.
Use weighted round-robin rotation with starvation protection across independent products.
Refill a released worker slot immediately when safe eligible work exists.
Debt/refactor/docs work cannot outrank usability capability work unless it blocks correctness, safety, verification, promotion, or the usability gate.
DIRECTION_REQUIRED triggers frontier refresh from authoritative product direction; it is not indefinite idle authority.
Never fabricate usability or Product Reality evidence.
